Every admissible kernel subset then occurs and yields a distinct induced type. The bundled verifier was read and its finite replay is consistent with this proof.

final_claim: If an infinite almost-chainable relational structure has kernel size \(k\), then its \(m\)-point profile is at most \(\sum_{j=0}^{\min(k,m)}\binom{k}{j}\), and this bound is simultaneously attained for every \(m\) by a structure with kernel exactly \(k\).
